author: The Current
description:
Cameron McCloud, founder and lead vocalist of hip-hop collective @CureforParanoia talked to The Current’s Morning Show about their song “No Brainer,” the winner of 2026’s Tiny Desk Contest.

Cure for Paranoia is performing tonight Tuesday, June 30 at Fine Line.

Read and listen to the full interview at thecurrent.org

author: The Current
description:
Channy Leaneagh of Poliça talks about recording an album across two nightclub sets
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

For their latest album, the band Poliça tried something new: They recorded the album before the live audience at Icehouse, a music venue in Minneapolis. The result is their new album, "Better Live," which released on February 26; the final recordings were made at Icehouse just eight days earlier, on February 18. 

During a visit to The Current's Morning Show, Poliça frontperson Channy Leaneagh talks about the process of recording the album over two nightclub shows. Watch more of what Leaneagh has to say in the video above.

author: The Current
description:
Watch Flock of Dimes perform "Everything Is Happening Today" in a small music venue in Minneapolis
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Flock of Dimes — the solo project of multi-instrumentalist and producer Jenn Wasner — released her third album, "The Life You Save," on October 10, 2025, on Sub Pop Records.

Wasner visited Minneapolis to perform a MicroShow — a series from The Current that presents live music in intimate or unexpected music venues — to perform songs from the new album as well as a few selections from her back catalogue. The audience in attendance comprised lucky winners who entered for a chance to attend this show.

Thank you to Gertens Garden Center for its support of this MicroShow.

Musicians
Jenn Wasner – vocals and guitar
Alan Good Parker – guitar
